The '''Spires of Victory''' was a monument located in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Spires were commissioned by [[Darth Gorgos]], a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], after the battle known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] that ended the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3653 BBY]]. Designed by the Empire's best [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and constructed by three hundred [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], the Spires were symbolic&mdash;the cascading prisms represented the ascendancy of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the downfall of their enemies, and the centerpiece signified the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. While Gorgos was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Darth Gorgos's apprentice|her apprentice]] before the Spires's completion, her successor on the Dark Council oversaw the monument's completion<ref name="Codex" /> before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spires of Victory first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], and its history is expanded on in a Codex entry.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The Spires appear in a vision of a ruined Kaas City to Imperial players in the [[2015]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']].<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref>
